name: Suzanne Bonamici
stance: Backs enforceable AI guardrails and safety standards — independent evaluations, human oversight and the NIST AI Risk Management Framework — framed around education and the workforce.

statements.text: I don’t think we can have 50 different systems; I think it needs to be done at the federal level.
Artificial intelligence can improve disaster preparedness and response, but we need clear rules and safeguards so powerful models don't cause the next disaster.

Introduced the AI Education and Workforce Readiness Act, a federal framework mandating AI risk-assessment standards, independent evaluations and audits, human oversight and adoption of the NIST AI Risk Management Framework.
The companies building these tools don't get to regulate themselves; we need clear rules and accountability for how AI is used in classrooms and workplaces.
